surface.description: PSC 0.2.4 adoption contract for public Agent tool membership and dispatch. Its existence does not attest that a running server has adopted it. schemaRef values identify files from the Core repository root; vendors verify a source-path-to-bytes map against the named Git commit and resolve it without network access. Adopting Gateways serve each inputSchema directly from the verified rulith-mcp-contract-bundle/v1 tools entry, including its generated definition names and explicit dialect. Object key order and JSON whitespace are immaterial; independently regenerated schema shapes are not the delivered contract.

inputSchema.description: OpenCase as the model sends it: business fields only. No kind (the tool name carries it), no identity, no envelope metadata.
Structured writes onto the shared graph. The inner operation names come from the Board batch contract; this shape references it rather than restating a second closed list.

d_02ae66a05cf634acfa705236.description: ApplyBatch 内层操作(名单与 TS WorkingMemoryOperation 联合类型逐项相等,RT-SCHEMA-2 执法;数不复述)。required=wire 地板(rulith-protocol 必填教学;id 不在其列——缺 id 权威端确定性自动补)。按权力分组见 protocol-spec §6:工作状态(assert/declare/retract/revise)·制度(add_axiom/define_action/derive_aggregate,受 law_locked 与 CD/CA 钉执法)·裁决记录(record_result)。

inputSchema.description: Invoke an Action the Board View currently shows as available. A Source-bound Action takes its logical source name inside args — never a Connection, credential, URL or local entry point.
Request a terminal state for one named acceptance boundary. Closing one root never closes another.

Bounded read of the Board View. queryContext is deliberately absent: the audience Profile is protected envelope metadata the Gateway derives from the authenticated request, and a model-facing shape that carried it would make the disclosure boundary something the caller sets. Omitting include returns the bounded Case directory; nodes, gaps and taskStatus each require an explicit selector.roots.

maxBytes.description: Requested upper bound; omission uses the configured read budget, larger requests are rejected rather than enlarging that budget.

d_32ec77a9bc592a5f4dbf3605.description: Service-minted opaque reference. Knowledge of it does not grant access; never a URL or filesystem path.

metadata.title: Rulith Host-only MCP metadata (rulith/v1)
metadata.description: Gateway output only. This value never enters the model tool schema or transcript. Session identity comes only from the authenticated Mcp-Session-Id header. Namespace and tool names are projections of protocol/mcp-surface.json.

affectedCases.description: Complete authoritative Case ids, not acceptance-root ids; absent for results that do not report a graph write. Never truncate silently.

ClientCapabilities.description: Declared in initialize.capabilities.experimental["rulith/v1"]. A compatibility declaration, never a grant of authority.

Handoff.description: The enclosing isError:true tool result contains a previous call result; the current request did not execute. Models receive only its authorized public content, not this metadata.

queryContext.title: Protected QueryBoard context
queryContext.description: Set by Gateway from authenticated request context, never accepted as Agent tool input. Core validates audience against authenticated principal before reading nodes. Audience enum is checked against QueryBoard.audienceProfiles in operations.json.

requestedRoots.description: Acceptance-root ids, not case ids. Omitted or [] requests no additional root summaries; this never supplies an Agent selector.roots prerequisite.

default.description: Absence means the agent base allowance; operator/internal cannot be granted through a default.

agent.description: Bounded read of the Board View. queryContext is deliberately absent: the audience Profile is protected envelope metadata the Gateway derives from the authenticated request, and a model-facing shape that carried it would make the disclosure boundary something the caller sets. Omitting include returns the bounded Case directory; nodes, gaps and taskStatus each require an explicit selector.roots.

operator.description: Console audit read, filtered by the operator Authority. Broader selectors than the Agent Profile, still bounded, and still refused without a Profile — no audience falls back to a whole-graph default.

d_264654f07e2f9ad726b6a795.description: The selector surface the operator and internal Profiles share. It is one definition rather than two copies: two copies of a disclosure surface drift, and the wider of the two wins by accident.

internal.description: Authenticated service-to-service read. Broadest selectors; still Authority/disclosure filtered and still Profile-gated.
